study type: Individual Patient Data (IPD) Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs)
cohort: The study included 2675 women (from five studies) and 2526 women (from four studies for IPD analysis) who were women of advanced maternal age (35 years or over) at term with intact membranes and a singleton or multiple pregnancy in a cephalic presentation.
finding: Induction of labour in women of advanced maternal age had no statistically significant effect on caesarean section rates.
mod_finding: Induction of labour in women of advanced maternal age showed no statistically significant increase in caesarean section rates compared to expectant management.
